sql:
with o as (
 select lo.id, lo.kalshi_order_id, lo.strategy, lo.market_ticker mt, lo.created_at, lo.side, lo.action, lo.limit_price, lo.quantity, lo.status, lo.cancel_reason
 from live_orders lo where lo.market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%'
), f as (
 select kalshi_order_id, sum(quantity) fq, avg(price) fpx, sum(fee) fee, min(filled_at) ff from fills where market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' group by 1
)
select o.strategy, o.status, o.side, o.action, count(*) orders, count(distinct o.mt) mkts, sum(o.quantity) qty, sum(coalesce(f.fq,0)) filled, round(avg(o.limit_price),1) lim,
 round(avg(extract(epoch from f.ff-o.created_at)/60)::numeric,1) min_to_fill, min(o.created_at)::date first, max(o.created_at)::date last,
 left(string_agg(distinct coalesce(o.cancel_reason,''),'|'),120) reasons
from o left join f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id group by 1,2,3,4 order by 1,2
